p: Colne is a hilltop market town in Pendle, East Lancashire, and Market Street is its main drag, sloping through the centre with independent shops, pubs and cafés along the way.

The town makes a decent base for exploring the area. Pendle Hill, with all its witch-trial folklore, looms over the district, and the countryside around Barnoldswick and Foulridge is great for walking, with the Leeds and Liverpool Canal not far away. Shoppers often head for Boundary Mill on the edge of Colne too. Admiral is an 18+ adult gaming centre rather than an arcade for all ages, so it's one for the grown-ups. Handy if you're passing through on the bus, since the bus station is right next door.
